The foreground grass blades have a slight 'melting' or overly soft appearance where they intersect with the shell, suggesting potential depth-of-field simulation artifacts common in AI generation.
The transition from the neck skin to the shell edge is slightly indistinct, with a minor blending of textures that could indicate a subtle boundary error.
